info.brief: A GUI applet: a node that shows one scene at a time, playing the old scene's transition
info.description:
A GUI applet: a node that shows one scene at a time, playing the old scene's transition
out while the new one transitions in. A GUI script creates it with `new`, and calls its
`update`, `final`, `on_message` and `on_input` from its own, which drive the scenes.

elements.name: new
elements.brief: Creates an applet on a node and, when given a scene class, shows a new scene of it.
elements.description: Creates an applet on a node and, when given a scene class, shows a new scene of it.

parameters.name: root
parameters.doc: The node, or the id `gui.get_node` looks it up by.

elements.description:
Creates an applet on a node and shows a scene built from a plain table of hooks and
fields, copied onto a fresh `wrap.gui_scene.extend()`.

parameters.name: root
parameters.doc: The node, or the id `gui.get_node` looks it up by.

parameters.name: scene
parameters.doc: The hooks and fields, each hook seeing the scene as `this`.

functions.name: register_scene
functions.brief: Registers a scene class under a name, for `show_scene` to show.
functions.description: Registers a scene class under a name, for `show_scene` to show.

functions.name: register_scene
functions.brief: Registers a scene built from a plain table of hooks and fields, whose keys are copied
functions.description:
Registers a scene built from a plain table of hooks and fields, whose keys are copied
onto a fresh `wrap.gui_scene.extend()` once, at registration.

parameters.name: scene
parameters.doc: The hooks and fields, each hook seeing the scene as `this`.

functions.name: unregister_scene
functions.brief: Removes the scene registered under a name.
functions.description: Removes the scene registered under a name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.doc: The name it was registered under.

functions.name: show_scene
functions.brief: Shows a new scene of the class registered under a name: sets it up with `setup`,
functions.description:
Shows a new scene of the class registered under a name: sets it up with `setup`,
which runs its `init`, starts its transition in, and starts the transition out of the
scene it replaces. Does nothing when no scene is registered under the name.

parameters.name: name_or_scene
parameters.doc: The name the scene was registered under.

functions.name: show_scene
functions.brief: Shows a new scene of a class, as the first form does.
functions.description: Shows a new scene of a class, as the first form does.

functions.name: show_scene
functions.brief: Shows a scene built from a plain table of hooks and fields, as the first form does.
functions.description:
Shows a scene built from a plain table of hooks and fields, as the first form does.
The keys are copied onto a fresh `wrap.gui_scene.extend()`, which is the scene shown.

parameters.name: name_or_scene
parameters.doc: The hooks and fields, each hook seeing the scene as `this`.

functions.name: get_size
functions.brief: Returns the size of the applet's root node, from `wrap.node.Node.get_size`.
functions.description: Returns the size of the applet's root node, from `wrap.node.Node.get_size`.

functions.name: update
functions.brief: Runs `bg_update` on the scene transitioning out, if any, then on the current scene.
functions.description:
Runs `bg_update` on the scene transitioning out, if any, then on the current scene.
Call it from the GUI script's `update`.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.doc: The time since the last frame, in seconds.

functions.name: final
functions.brief: Finalizes the current scene with `bg_final`. Call it from the GUI script's `final`.
functions.description: Finalizes the current scene with `bg_final`. Call it from the GUI script's `final`.

functions.brief: Passes a message to the current scene's `bg_on_message`. Call it from the GUI
functions.description:
Passes a message to the current scene's `bg_on_message`. Call it from the GUI
script's `on_message`.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.doc: The url of the message's sender.

functions.name: on_input
functions.brief: Passes input to the current scene's `bg_on_input`. Call it from the GUI script's
functions.description:
Passes input to the current scene's `bg_on_input`. Call it from the GUI script's

parameters.name: action_id
parameters.doc: The input action's id, or `nil` for mouse movement.

returnvalues.doc: Whether the scene consumed the input; `false` when no scene is shown.

properties.name: root
properties.brief: The wrapped node the applet was created on. Each scene's root is created under it.
